result.reasoning: This commit refactored the reclaim() method in PatriciaTreeMutable.java to cache `source.currentNode` and `actual.currentNode` into local variables `sourceNode`/`actualNode` at the top of the loop. However, within the loop body, `source.moveDown()` mutates `source.currentNode`, making the cached `sourceNode` stale. The subsequent code incorrectly continued to reference the stale `sourceNode` variable (instead of re-fetching `source.currentNode`) when computing children and re-initializing `srcItr`, causing the "weird reclaim bug" fixed by b1fbad54f2ac, which reverts those specific usages back to `source.currentNode`.
